description: React component for rendering the title section of a user profile popover, including role tags and close button, with logic for determining user roles such as admin, guest, bot, etc.

methods.name: getIsTeamAdmin
methods.description: Determines if a user is a team admin based on the global state and user ID.

methods.name: getIsChannelAdmin
methods.description: Determines if a user is a channel admin within a specific channel, considering RHS state.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Handles closing the popover, invoking hide and returnFocus callbacks.
